source.description:

sentences.text: Corey Clipson, founder and CEO of Swam Bitcoin.
Thanks so much for joining us.
It was great having you.
Thank you.
See you in Amsterdam.
Well, Bitcoin is valuable because of the ownership, control, and liquidity that it gives you.
The challenge has always been finding ways to make Bitcoin more useful without giving up the properties that made you want to own it in the first place.
That's what's attractive about Verified X, the Bitcoin custody sponsor of BMTV.

Verified X is designed to let you use Bitcoin across things like payments, borrowing, lending, trading, treasury management, and settlement without requiring you to wrap it into a synthetic asset or hand control over to a third party.
And importantly for Bitcoins, Verified X is built around self -custody.
You maintain control of your own signing while still being able to access native Bitcoin liquidity across programmable financial applications and integrated venues like exchanges.
The idea is to expand what you can do with Bitcoin without compromising what makes Bitcoin valuable in the first place.
Keep Bitcoin as Bitcoin and activate it.
Explore VerifiedX and see how Bitcoin can move, settle, and work across programmable financial networks at verifiedx.io.
Digital assets involve risk.
Learn more before participate it.
Coming up next, how Bitcoin miners are using waste heat to adapt to a changing market.
And what's next for Bitcoin's hash rate?
Tyler Stevens, the founder and CEO of Exergy, joins the show next to discuss more.
Bitcoin can help diversify how you spend, save, and invest in your business, especially when every swipe of a credit card eats away at your bottom line.
Let's say you run a local grocery chain.
Most purchases are small, like a bag of produce or a gallon of milk.
so credit card fees start to add up fast.
But Square, you can now accept Bitcoin, with zero payment processing fees, no chargebacks, and near instant access to funds.
And you choose how money settles into your account, whether in USD or Bitcoin, instantly and right from your square dashboard.
Whether you're aiming for short -term goals or planning for the long haul, you can automatically convert a percentage of your daily card sales into Bitcoin, no extra steps, no added complexity.
It's a smart, seamless way to build savings in the background, all while keeping your day -to -day cash flow predictable.
And when tax time comes, you'll get the paperwork you need right where you find your reports and bank statement.
Bitcoin is just another way for you to take control of how your business makes and spends money.
Enable Bitcoin payments and conversions in your square dashboard.
Head to squareup.com slash Bitcoin to learn more.
